name: BRICK SNAKE 2000

features.name: Snek Spins
features.description: Extra scatters become sneks in the bonus.

review:
BRICK SNAKE 2000 is a 5x5 retro arcade slot inspired by classic snake games. A Wild Snek can land anywhere and moves one to five steps in any direction except backwards, turning everything it passes into a wild. xWays symbols reveal stacks of two to five matching symbols.

Three or four scatters start Snek Spins, converting extra scatters into sneks; five give Super Snek Spins. Nolimit rates it Insane volatility, with an 8,110x cap. The pixel art and chiptune audio make it one of the studio's more playful releases.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
